title: Reserved `focused` stage name is applied in the foreground path only; docs/test.md states it for carried gates too
outcome: docs/test.md (~line 420) says the stage name `focused` is reserved, so a full gate's stage of that name is never a test stage, under a rule stated for foreground and carried gates alike. Only the foreground path (engram_launcher_output_test_stages) drops the name. The carried path (engram_read_carried_run, src/engram_carried_checks.rs:904) still calls engram_launcher_test_stages unfiltered, so a carried kinded full gate whose only test stage is named `focused` would be credited. No real gate uses the name; it is not a weakening. Either apply the filter inside engram_launcher_test_stages (both paths, with a carried test) or narrow the sentence to the foreground.
acceptance: Reserved `focused` stage name is applied in the foreground path only; docs/test.md states it for carried gates too is done
